claims.gist: Vendor evaluations help build shortlists and sharpen questions, not make purchases
Each evaluation compares vendors against the same criteria on two axes
Evaluations are refreshed every 12 to 24 months depending on market change
Vendors do not pay to be included in or left out of evaluations
Analysts' compensation is not tied to vendor revenue
Vendors may fact-check their profiles but cannot change scores or analysis
Choosing the vendor furthest up and to the right is the most common buyer mistake
The top-scoring vendor fits a typical buyer, and most buyers are not typical

thesis: Vendor evaluations build shortlists and better questions; top scorers fit typical buyers, not necessarily you.
